mapper.update: UPDATE mq_outbox SET status = 1, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND retry_count < #{maxRetryCount} AND ( status = 0 OR (status = 3 AND next_attempt_time <= NOW()) OR (status = 1 AND lease_until <= NOW()) )
UPDATE mq_outbox SET status = 2, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1

UPDATE mq_outbox SET status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_attempt_time = #{nextAttemptTime}, lease_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
